description: This is a PHP source file defining the AdminController class for the Goteo project. It manages administration-related routes, subcontrollers, user permissions, and view rendering for the admin interface.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: Main controller class for managing admin routes and subcontrollers within the Goteo project.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the default admin index page, listing subcontrollers.

methods.name: routingAction
methods.description: Routes requests to specific admin submodules based on the URL.

methods.name: createAdminSidebar
methods.description: Builds the admin sidebar menu based on user permissions and subcontrollers.

methods.name: getGroupLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for a given group key for UI display.

methods.name: addSubController
methods.description: Registers a new subcontroller class for admin routes.

methods.name: existsSubController
methods.description: Checks if a given subcontroller class is registered.

methods.name: getSubController
methods.description: Retrieves a subcontroller class by its ID.

methods.name: delSubController
methods.description: Removes a subcontroller class from registration.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a user has admin permissions based on subcontrollers.

methods.name: indexOldAction
methods.description: Legacy method for admin index page, showing default feed.

methods.name: checkCurrentUser
methods.description: Validates user permissions and prepares the admin menu context.

methods.name: optionAction
methods.description: Dispatches requests to specific subcontrollers or views based on parameters.
